## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!wordguess` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --mint: #2ed8a7; --yellow: #ffc93c; --pink: #ff4f8b; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --miss: #3b2d7a; --miss-text: #d8d0ff; --tile: min(42px, 11vw); }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: linear-gradient(170deg, var(--sky), var(--violet)); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; user-select: none; -webkit-user-select: none; }
  header { width: min(94vw, 300px); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
  #status { min-width: 0; height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cream); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .3); font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #status.bad { background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #b8285c; animation: nudge .3s; }
  #again { flex: none; min-height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .3); font: 800 13px system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }
  #again.primary { background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #b8285c; }
  #again:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .3); }
  #grid { display: grid; grid-template-rows: repeat(6, var(--tile)); gap: 5px; }
  .row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, var(--tile)); gap: 5px; }
  .row.shake { animation: shake .3s; }
  .tile { position: relative; border: 2px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .55); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .16); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 800 calc(var(--tile) * .5)/1 system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .tile.typed { border-color: var(--cream); background: var(--cream); animation: tap .14s ease-out; }
  .correct, .present, .absent { border-color: transparent; }
  .tile.correct, .tile.present, .tile.absent { animation: reveal .3s ease-out both; box-shadow: inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .2); }
  .correct { background: var(--mint); color: var(--ink); }
  .present { background: var(--yellow); color: var(--ink); }
  .absent { background: var(--miss); color: var(--miss-text); }
  .correct::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink); }
  .present::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 24%; right: 24%; bottom: 5px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ink); }
  .row.won .tile { animation: hop .5s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.8, .5, 1) both; }
  @keyframes reveal { from { transform: rotateX(90deg); } }
  @keyframes tap { 50% { transform: scale(1.1); } }
  @keyframes hop { 40% { transform: translateY(-10px); } }
  @keyframes shake { 25% { transform: translateX(-6px); } 75% { transform: translateX(6px); } }
  @keyframes nudge { 50% { transform: scale(1.06); } }
  #keys { width: min(96vw, 420px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; padding-bottom: 3px; }
  .keyrow { display: flex; gap: 4px; }
  .keyrow i { flex: .5; }
  .key { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; height: 40px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--cream); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #4b3bb0; font: 800 15px/1 system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; }
  .key.wide { flex: 1.5; font-size: 12px; text-transform: none; }
  .key:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 #4b3bb0; }
  .key.correct { background: var(--mint); }
  .key.present { background: var(--yellow); }
  .key.absent { background: var(--miss); color: var(--miss-text); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #251a52; }
  .key.correct::before { top: 3px; right: 3px; width: 5px; height: 5px; }
  .key.present::after { bottom: 5px; }
  .confetti { position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; pointer-events: none; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .row.shake, .tile.typed, .tile.correct, .tile.present, .tile.absent, .row.won .tile, #status.bad { animation: none; } }
</style>
<header>
  <span id="status" aria-live="polite">Guess the 5-letter word</span>
  <button id="again" type="button">New round</button>
</header>
<div id="grid"></div>
<div id="keys" aria-label="Keyboard"></div>
<script>
  var ANSWERS = 'about actor after agree alarm alive allow alone apple award beach begin bench black blank block board brain bread break brick bring brown brush build candy chain chair charm chart cheap check child class clean clear climb clock cloud coach coast couch count cover crane cream dance dream dress drink drive early earth eight empty enjoy enter field final floor flour fresh fruit ghost giant glass grape grass great green group guest guide happy heart heavy honey horse hotel house juice knife laugh learn lemon light lucky lunch magic match money mouse mouth movie music night noise ocean olive paint paper party peace phone photo piano pizza place plane plant plate price prize queen quick quiet radio river robot round salad sheep shirt sleep smile snake sound spoon sport start stone storm sugar sunny sweet table thank tiger toast today tower train truck uncle watch water whale wheel white zebra'.split(' ');
  var EXTRA = 'abide abort above abuse acorn acute adapt admit adopt adult again agent aging ahead aisle album alert alien align alike alley alloy aloft aloud alpha altar alter amber amend among ample yield young youth yummy zesty'.split(' ');
  var TEXT = { start: 'Guess the 5-letter word', short: 'Need 5 letters', unknown: 'Not in the word list', lose: 'The word was ', win: 'Solved in ', tries: 'Try ' };
  var ROWS = 6, LEN = 5;
  var KEYS = ['qwertyuiop', ' asdfghjkl ', '>zxcvbnm<'];
  var RANK = { absent: 1, present: 2, correct: 3 };

  function score(guess, answer) {
    var result = [], left = {};
    for (var i = 0; i < LEN; i++) {
      if (guess[i] === answer[i]) result[i] = 'correct';
      else left[answer[i]] = (left[answer[i]] || 0) + 1;
    }
    for (var j = 0; j < LEN; j++) {
      if (result[j]) continue;
      if (left[guess[j]]) { result[j] = 'present'; left[guess[j]]--; }
      else result[j] = 'absent';
    }
    return result;
  }

  var VALID = {};
  ANSWERS.concat(EXTRA).forEach(function (w) { VALID[w] = true; });

  var gridEl = document.getElementById('grid');
  var keysEl = document.getElementById('keys');
  var statusEl = document.getElementById('status');
  var againBtn = document.getElementById('again');
  var answer, row, current, done, letterState, round = 0, keyEls = {};

  for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
    var rowEl = document.createElement('div');
    rowEl.className = 'row';
    rowEl.setAttribute('role', 'group');
    for (var c = 0; c < LEN; c++) {
      var tile = document.createElement('div');
      tile.className = 'tile';
      tile.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      rowEl.appendChild(tile);
    }
    gridEl.appendChild(rowEl);
  }

  KEYS.forEach(function (letters) {
    var line = document.createElement('div');
    line.className = 'keyrow';
    letters.split('').forEach(function (ch) {
      if (ch === ' ') { line.appendChild(document.createElement('i')); return; }
      var key = document.createElement('button');
      key.type = 'button';
      key.className = 'key' + (ch === '>' || ch === '<' ? ' wide' : '');
      key.textContent = ch === '>' ? 'Enter' : ch === '<' ? '⌫' : ch;
      if (ch === '<') key.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Delete');
      key.addEventListener('click', function () { press(ch === '>' ? 'enter' : ch === '<' ? 'delete' : ch); });
      if (ch !== '>' && ch !== '<') keyEls[ch] = key;
      line.appendChild(key);
    });
    keysEl.appendChild(line);
  });

  function say(text, bad) {
    statusEl.textContent = text;
    statusEl.className = '';
    if (bad) { void statusEl.offsetWidth; statusEl.className = 'bad'; }
  }

  function paintRow() {
    var tiles = gridEl.children[row].children;
    for (var i = 0; i < LEN; i++) {
      tiles[i].textContent = current[i] || '';
      tiles[i].className = 'tile' + (current[i] ? ' typed' : '');
    }
  }

  function paintKey(ch) {
    var state = letterState[ch];
    keyEls[ch].className = 'key' + (state ? ' ' + state : '');
    keyEls[ch].setAttribute('aria-label', ch.toUpperCase() + (state ? ', ' + state : ''));
  }

  function submit() {
    var rowEl = gridEl.children[row];
    if (current.length < LEN || !VALID[current]) {
      say(current.length < LEN ? TEXT.short : TEXT.unknown, true);
      rowEl.classList.remove('shake');
      void rowEl.offsetWidth;
      rowEl.classList.add('shake');
      return;
    }
    var result = score(current, answer), spoken = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < LEN; i++) {
      var ch = current[i];
      rowEl.children[i].className = 'tile ' + result[i];
      rowEl.children[i].style.animationDelay = (i * 60) + 'ms';
      if (!letterState[ch] || RANK[result[i]] > RANK[letterState[ch]]) letterState[ch] = result[i];
      paintKey(ch);
      spoken.push(ch.toUpperCase() + ' ' + result[i]);
    }
    rowEl.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Guess ' + (row + 1) + ': ' + current.toUpperCase() + '. ' + spoken.join(', '));
    var solved = current === answer;
    row++;
    current = '';
    if (solved || row === ROWS) {
      done = true;
      say(solved ? TEXT.win + row + '/' + ROWS + '! 🎉' : TEXT.lose + answer.toUpperCase());
      againBtn.className = 'primary';
      if (solved) {
        var thisRound = round;
        setTimeout(function () { if (thisRound !== round) return; rowEl.classList.add('won'); confetti(); }, LEN * 60 + 300);
      }
      againBtn.focus();
    } else say(TEXT.tries + (row + 1) + ' of ' + ROWS);
  }

  function press(key) {
    if (done) return;
    if (key === 'enter') { submit(); return; }
    if (key === 'delete') current = current.slice(0, -1);
    else if (current.length < LEN) current += key;
    else return;
    say(TEXT.tries + (row + 1) + ' of ' + ROWS);
    paintRow();
  }

  function confetti() {
    if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    var cv = document.createElement('canvas'), w = window.innerWidth, h = window.innerHeight, r = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    var g = cv.getContext('2d'), bits = [], colors = ['#ff4f8b', '#ffc93c', '#2ed8a7', '#fff8ec', '#38b6ff', '#ff8a3d'], t0 = 0;
    cv.className = 'confetti';
    cv.width = w * r;
    cv.height = h * r;
    document.body.appendChild(cv);
    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++) bits.push({ x: w / 2, y: h * 0.35, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 10, vy: -3 - Math.random() * 9, s: 6 + Math.random() * 5, a: Math.random() * 6, c: colors[i % colors.length] });
    function frame(now) {
      if (!t0) t0 = now;
      var t = now - t0;
      g.setTransform(r, 0, 0, r, 0, 0);
      g.clearRect(0, 0, w, h);
      g.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - t / 1500);
      bits.forEach(function (b) {
        b.vy += 0.3; b.x += b.vx; b.y += b.vy; b.a += 0.2;
        g.save(); g.translate(b.x, b.y); g.rotate(b.a); g.fillStyle = b.c; g.fillRect(-b.s / 2, -b.s / 4, b.s, b.s / 2); g.restore();
      });
      if (t < 1500) requestAnimationFrame(frame); else cv.remove();
    }
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
  }

  function newRound() {
    round++;
    var old = document.querySelectorAll('.confetti');
    for (var k = 0; k < old.length; k++) old[k].remove();
    answer = ANSWERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * ANSWERS.length)];
    row = 0;
    current = '';
    done = false;
    letterState = {};
    for (var r = 0; r < ROWS; r++) {
      var rowEl = gridEl.children[r];
      rowEl.removeAttribute('aria-label');
      rowEl.className = 'row';
      for (var i = 0; i < LEN; i++) {
        rowEl.children[i].className = 'tile';
        rowEl.children[i].textContent = '';
        rowEl.children[i].style.animationDelay = '';
      }
    }
    for (var ch in keyEls) paintKey(ch);
    againBtn.className = '';
    say(TEXT.start);
  }

  againBtn.addEventListener('click', newRound);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
    var k = e.key.toLowerCase();
    if (k === 'enter') { if (done) return; e.preventDefault(); press('enter'); }
    else if (k === 'backspace') press('delete');
    else if (k.length === 1 && k >= 'a' && k <= 'z') press(k);
  });

  newRound();
</script>
`

client.command('wordguess', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Word guess",
    height: 478,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "Word guess opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
